concerns.text: FR-004 requires computing a permutation test as a Gold Standard reference. Task T026 implements the generator, but T027 (KS calculation comparing standard tests to permutation reference) is marked unchecked. Without T027, the system cannot compute the KS statistic against the permutation reference, leaving FR-004 unfulfilled.

FR-001 requires generating data with specific discrete correlation thresholds ρ ∈ {0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9}. Task T013 describes generating data for a 'range' without explicitly committing to this discrete set. Task T015 mentions a 'parameter sweep' but lacks the explicit enumeration of the required ρ values, risking a mismatch with FR-007 sensitivity analysis requirements.

FR-003 requires collecting exactly p p-values per iteration. Task T021 (implementing collection logic) is unchecked. Task T017 (storing full trajectories) is also unchecked. The primary data pipeline for FR-002 and FR-003 lacks a verified implementation artifact for the collection and storage steps.

FR-007 requires performing sensitivity analysis sweeping ρ ∈ {0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9} and reporting KS variations. Task T029 (Implement sensitivity analysis sweep) is unchecked. Without this task, the system cannot fulfill the sensitivity analysis requirement.
FR-005 requires producing QQ-plots. Task T028 (Implement QQ-plot generation) is unchecked. The visual inspection requirement remains unimplemented.

FR-009 requires detecting singular covariance matrices and raising a specific error code ERR_HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_INSTABILITY. Task T004.5 (Define error code) is unchecked. Task T004 (Implement covariance regularization) is checked, but without the error code definition, the specific error raising requirement of FR-009 is incomplete.

Task T017.1 and T022.1 reference 'Prior Review: Feynman' comments not present in spec.md or plan.md. These tasks introduce scope creep (generating 'worst-case' datasets and visualizers) without a corresponding Functional Requirement in the spec, creating a disconnect between the task list and the approved specification.

Task T030.1 requires generating a 'Deviation Report' in docs/deviation_report.md. While useful, spec.md SC-001 and SC-002 define success criteria based on KS statistics and bias magnitude metrics, not a narrative report. This task may represent a deliverable mismatch with the defined success criteria.
